### Problem Resolved
`scripts/design-adherence-guidance.mjs` previously injected the full upstream Anthropic `frontend-design/SKILL.md` verbatim into every creative authoring and visual repair request, contradicting both `docs/design-guidance/anthropic/frontend-design/README.md` and LaunchLoom's binding contracts (`TEMPLATE_ADHERENCE_CONTRACT`, read-only `--ll-*`/`--font-*` tokens, and sealed `content.*` bindings) by asking code-authoring models to invent copy/placeholders, pick free 4-6 hex palettes, choose arbitrary typefaces, and reject reference-prescribed layouts.

### Changes Implemented
- **[`scripts/design-adherence-guidance.mjs`](../../../scripts/design-adherence-guidance.mjs):**
  - Preserved `FRONTEND_DESIGN_SKILL_PATH`, `frontendDesignGuidance()`, and `frontendDesignGuidanceBlock()` against the unchanged Apache-2.0 review copy on disk.
  - Added `frontendDesignCopyGuidance()` / `frontendDesignCopyGuidanceBlock()` projecting the `"More on writing in design"` section for the upstream copy lane under LaunchLoom's verified-facts and no-em-dash constraints.
  - Added `frontendDesignAuthoringGuidance()` / `frontendDesignAuthoringGuidanceBlock()` projecting only visual-craft/restraint guidance for authoring and repair, stripping placeholder-copy invention, free-palette/typeface brainstorming, and studio-reinvention framing.
  - Added aesthetic-neutral `INTERFACE_CRAFT_GUIDANCE` (concentric border radii, optical alignment, crisp neutral image outlines, typography polish, compositor-only motion hygiene, semantic HTML, `:focus-visible`, `scroll-margin-top`, `44x44px` touch targets, overflow/CLS guards).
  - Added `REPAIR_CRITIQUE_GUIDANCE` (bounded refinement discipline, 4-tier triage order, root-cause classification `missing-token` | `structural-layout` | `reference-drift` | `local-craft-defect`, and structured repair verbs `harden`, `align`, `distill`, `polish`).
  - Updated `designAdherencePromptBlock({ mode = "author" } = {})` to assemble `TEMPLATE_ADHERENCE_CONTRACT` + scoped authoring guidance + `INTERFACE_CRAFT_GUIDANCE` (plus `REPAIR_CRITIQUE_GUIDANCE` when `mode === "repair"`).
- **[`scripts/generate-site-config.mjs`](../../../scripts/generate-site-config.mjs):** Wired `frontendDesignCopyGuidanceBlock()` into both `askModel()` and `refineDraft()` system prompts.
- **[`scripts/creative-repair-loop.mjs`](../../../scripts/creative-repair-loop.mjs):** Switched repair context injection to `designAdherencePromptBlock({ mode: "repair" })`.
- **[`scripts/rendered-reference-fidelity.mjs`](../../../scripts/rendered-reference-fidelity.mjs):** Added explicit anti-slop visual checks (nested cards, unrequested eyebrow kickers, one-sided accent bars on rounded boxes, zero-offset colored glows, flat type scale, mismatched nested radii) subordinate to assigned Reference DNA.
- **[`docs/design-guidance/anthropic/frontend-design/README.md`](../../../docs/design-guidance/anthropic/frontend-design/README.md):** Updated documentation to reflect the lane-scoped injection architecture accurately.
- **Tests:** Expanded `tests/design-adherence-guidance.test.ts`, `tests/site-config.test.ts`, and `tests/creative-repair-loop.test.ts`.
